articles.headline: Bregman walk-off lifts Red Sox over Blue Jays
articles.description: Alex Bregman launched a 9th-inning solo shot to give Boston a 6-4 series-opening win.

articles.headline: Celtics-76ers Game 5 set for Thursday at the Garden
articles.description: The C's lead the series 3-1 and have a chance to close it out at home.

recent_dan_output.headline: Celtics one win away as the Sox keep grinding through the early gauntlet
morning_brew: C's lead 3-1 over Philly and Game 5 is at the Garden Thursday. Close it out at home and avoid a back-to-Philly Game 6. The Tatum-Brown-Pritchard trio has been carving the Sixers' second unit, and the bench is finally giving them rest.
Sox dropped one to Toronto last night, 5-2. Bello couldn't find the strike zone in the 4th and the bullpen never recovered. Two of three for the series is still on the table.

A week into life without the Pats' draft class on the headlines and the front office is reportedly kicking tires on a veteran receiver. Drake Maye needs a real number one. We'll see if Wolf pulls the trigger.

recent_dan_output.headline: Bregman walks one off as the C's keep their boot on Philly's neck
morning_brew: Bregman, ninth inning, gone. Red Sox 6, Toronto 4. That is exactly the kind of veteran at-bat this lineup paid for.
C's took Game 4 in Philly. Three-one lead and Game 5 back at the Garden. Banner 19 talk is starting to leak out of the talk-radio fringe and into actual press conferences.
Three days removed from the draft and the Patriots are reportedly active on the trade market. Nothing concrete yet but the hot stove is definitely on.
